Nearly all websites use cookies. The recent announcement on many sites is fairly new, and I'm not sure if there was a legal change requiring sites to announce their use, or if it's just a transparency thing many sites are doing now.

Cookies are stored data in your browser that let the site know if you are logged in or logged out, whether your preferences want the light or dark mode of the site, etc.

Generally, and by design, cookies are supposed to expire within a day or two. Nefarious cookies, such as google or amazon ones, are set to stay in your browser for longer than you will live. These are the bad cookies, as they are used to track you across multiple websites.

Voat has features that require cookies to work. Though I do not know how long those cookies are set to be saved.
